svg.title: Korean decisions reach Europe
svg.desc: Geographic Eurasia context with two explicitly schematic relationships: South Korea to Poland, defense equipment; North Korea to Russia, military support. Arrows connect approximate capital-city locators, not verified shipment routes or battlefield positions. Natural Earth country outlines do not imply endorsement of territorial claims.
svg.text: Natural Earth 1:50m · arrows anchored at state capitals · Mercator
